name: YITA-50P-C
summary: An integrated robot joint module in YITA Dynamics’ C series, combining precision transmission, drive control and dual absolute-encoder feedback. This model has a 2.2 N·m rated torque, 11 N·m peak torque and 0.3 kg mass. It supports EtherCAT and CAN FD and includes a through-bore for routing.
